title: 列表在非安全连接（普通 http、非 localhost）下点表头排序报错且不排序：多处直接调用 crypto.randomUUID
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Split from #35549 by seat 5 (area ux-1): an out-of-scope finding from the PR 2 dev report (7022170405). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens today

- `crypto.randomUUID()` exists only in a secure context (https, or `localhost`).
- In Chromium with `isSecureContext === false` (measured on `about:blank`), a grid header click threw `TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`, and no sort was applied.
- A Console served over plain http from a host other than localhost would hit the same error. That was not measured on a real deployment.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` calls it unguarded at `handleHeaderSort` and two other sites (lines 876, 882 and 6028 at eca20d2219).
- `conditions/conditionModel.ts` `newConditionId` already guards the same call.
- Other unguarded call sites in `ui/packages/*/src` at eca20d2219, unverified for reach:
  - `components/custom/{sort,filter}-builder.tsx`
  - `app-shell` `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `viewFilterFold.ts` and `ScriptCapabilitiesField.tsx`
  - `core/actions/TransactionManager.ts`
  - `plugin-chatbot/utils.ts`
  - `plugin-view` `view-config-utils.ts` and `SharedViewLink.tsx`
  - `types` `complex.ts` and `complex.zod.ts`

## What to do

1. Use one shared id helper, which falls back when `randomUUID` is absent, in place of each bare call. Reuse the guarded shape from `newConditionId`.
2. Pin it: with `crypto.randomUUID` deleted, a header-click sort still applies.

## Done when

In a non-secure context, header sort, filter and sort builders and the other listed sites mint ids without throwing. A test pins the fallback.
